outputs.explanation: Panel A shows fluorescence micrographs of cells (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, merge) — not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
The bottom bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean bars with error bars and significance asterisks; no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantitative plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts show group means with error bars and sample sizes (N) indicated inside the bars, but no individual data points are plotted.

Panel E shows FACS histogram plots (cell counts vs. TMRM intensity), which are line/frequency distribution plots; overlaying individual points is not applicable to this plot type and the distributions themselves convey the underlying data.
